targets.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (α β ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε)
 (x : Vec n) (mark : Fin n → Bool → ℝ) (j : Fin m) (q : Bool),
 canonicalIntegral 1 α β (networkGame net ε hε x j q)
   (networkObservation net ε hε x mark j q) =
 traceObservation (routingTrace α β ε net x) mark j q
targets.scope: Complete actual canonical game-history scalar integral, for arbitrary signed raw inputs; α and β may be real for the algebraic identity.

targets.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (α β ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε)
 (x : Vec n) (j : Fin m) (q : Bool) (i : Fin n) (r : Bool),
 networkOccupation net α β ε hε x j q i r =
 rgOccupation net α β ε x j i (Bool.xor q r)
targets.scope: Endpoint occupation of the actual complete canonical history law equals the independently defined ordinary-path discounted occupation. Absorbed histories remain in the actual law with zero endpoint mark.

targets.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (α β ε : ℝ)
 (hα : 0≤α) (hβ : 0≤β) (hε : 0≤ε) (x : Vec n)
 (j : Fin m) (q : Bool) (i : Fin n) (r : Bool),
 0 ≤ networkOccupation net α β ε hε x j q i r
targets.scope: Nonnegative discounted occupations require nonnegative branch coefficients; includes zero stabilizer and empty streams.

targets.expected_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (α β ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε)
 (x : Vec n) (R : Vec m) (i : Fin n),
 lrp α β ε net x R i = ∑ j, R j *
 (networkOccupation net α β ε hε x j true i true -
  networkOccupation net α β ε hε x j true i false)
targets.scope: Actual canonical game-history recovery of the shared layered-network alpha-beta rule, with existing stopping-at-ties convention.

targets.expected_type:
∀ {d k n m : ℕ} (wp wn : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) (bp bn : Vec k)
 (pre : Network k n) (suffix : Network n m) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (x : Vec d),
 networkGame ((Network.layer wp wn bp bn pre).append suffix) ε hε x =
 propagate ε hε suffix (networkGame (Network.layer wp wn bp bn pre) ε hε x)
targets.scope: Literal original-tree composition for nonempty prefix; no replacement of full lower history by an independent suffix.

targets.expected_type:
∀ {d k n m : ℕ} (wp wn : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) (bp bn : Vec k)
 (pre : Network k n) (suffix : Network n m) (α β ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (x : Vec d)
 (j : Fin m) (q : Bool) (i : Fin n) (r : Bool),
 intermediateOccupation suffix α β ε hε
   (networkGame (Network.layer wp wn bp bn pre) ε hε x) j q i r =
 rgOccupation suffix α β ε ((Network.layer wp wn bp bn pre).eval x)
   j i (Bool.xor q r)
targets.scope: Marked root visits in the complete original appended-network game integrate all lower prefix histories; equality to the cut occupation is proved, with a nonempty activation prefix.
